intro: Stolen Blasting Powder concerns an empty, hazardous explosive keg discovered among troggs near Gol'Bolar Quarry. Bringing the missing container to Quarrymaster Thesten exposes a perilous breach in the quarry's security and explosive stores.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER
You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
